issues.description: The template's Bitmap24.hpp declares the member 'data' as int *data, while Bitmap24.cpp (in the same template) allocates and treats 'data' as a char buffer (new char[...] and byte-wise indexing). The solution repository's Bitmap24.hpp correctly declares 'data' as char *. This type mismatch in the template will cause compilation errors and confuses students about the intended storage type for bitmap pixel data.
issues.suggestedFix: In the template, change the Bitmap24::data member declaration from 'int *data;' to 'char *data;' so it matches how the buffer is allocated and used in Bitmap24.cpp. Ensure any other references or comments that assume an int* are updated accordingly so the template compiles and reflects the intended byte-oriented bitmap storage.
